Mr. Rime

Ice Psychic

Galar · Generation 8

Mr. Rime is an Ice/Psychic-type Comedian Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 58.2 kg. It evolves from Mr. Mime. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (110), with a base stat total of 520.
